author: Neville Goddard
quote_original: At the end of my day, I review the day; I don’t judge it, I simply review it. I look over the entire day, all the episodes, all the events, all the conversations, all the meetings, and then as I see it clearly in my mind’s eye, I rewrite it. I rewrite it and make it conform to the ideal day I wish I had experienced.
editorial_note: Self-directed daily revision procedure retained; boundary ends before categorical future-change and direct-other causation claims.
